newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April dept store sales fall 14.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan April dept store sales fall 14.0 pct.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Japan in April declined 14.0 percent from a year earlier to 604.1 billion yen, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Monday.
The large drop was due to a decline in sales after a surge in March ahead of the April 1 increase in Japan's sales tax to five percent from three percent, the association said in a statement.
April sales started off slowly due to poor weather, but a slight improvement was seen in sales of clothing in Tokyo in the latter half of the month, it added.
Purchases by both individual and corporate customers declined, it said.
The survey covered 263 outlets of 108 companies.
